integrity: The counterexample and range criterion are exact symbolic arguments. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The universal criterion concerns all \(K\)-frames for a fixed \(K\). For one fixed frame with synthesis \(V\), the exact condition is \(R(K)\subseteq S R(V)\), which can be weaker. An unindexed correction may exist.
title: Positive transforms of \(K\)-frames require a range condition
